probe_mode.description: combined = all probes share one cook, individual = each probe is independent.

probe_index.name: Probe index
probe_index.description: Which probe to start: its number minus 1 (0–3), so probe 4 is 3 even if probes 2 and 3 are unused. Only used in individual mode.
